title: Man, teenage daughter killed as irrigation canal collapses in Lamjung
contentSnippet: Two family members die, and two others are injured after a canal embankment gives way, burying the granary where they had been living in Madhya Nepal Municipality.

title: Curfew lifted in Sunsari’s Dewanganj as tensions ease
contentSnippet: Authorities lift the curfew but retain limits on gatherings in Dewanganj and Harinagar after Sunday’s communal clash left one dead and nine injured in security force firing.

title: Health Ministry urges hospitals to keep services running amid doctors’ protest
contentSnippet: The directive comes as the Nepal Medical Association suspends non-emergency services nationwide over the Narayani Hospital attack, while the ministry says authorities are taking steps to bring those involved to justice.

title: Doctors halt non-emergency services nationwide over Birgunj attack
contentSnippet: The Nepal Medical Association announces a nationwide protest and Tuesday shutdown of non-emergency services after the Narayani Hospital attack, while Birgunj doctors submit mass resignations.
